tasks.short: Teach pharmacy interns for professional qualification

steps.what: Prepare pharmacy teaching cases and materials for interns' learning needs
Teach pharmacy students, observe practice and give individual feedback

tasks.design: Configure a reusable case and material library in {DOCS} or the existing {LMS}. The pharmacist selects and checks material against the intern's needs, then keeps live teaching, observation and feedback intact.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated material retrieval and assembly consumes some preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tags and reusable lesson structures can reduce assembly without generating clinical answers.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing what the intern understands and correcting unsafe reasoning or practice.
tasks.human_edge: The pharmacist can stop a dangerous action and explain why the intern's reasoning failed.
tasks.altitude: Less preparation assembly, with teaching and qualification responsibilities unchanged.

reach.task: Demonstrate an approved operational procedure to an intern under supervision

evidence.claim: A reusable material library can shorten preparation assembly without replacing intern observation and feedback; savings are modelled.

assumptions: Boundary is pharmacist teaching and preparation, excluding intern labour and formal licensure decisions.
Pharmacist identifies objective, intern stage, case suitability and source version in s1; all selection, capture and checks fit its retained 15 hours. No ready competence score is assumed.
Only existing approved or fictional teaching cases are reused; patient records are not copied into a library. Missing suitable material is prepared manually within retained time.
Test native library functions before custom code; current reuse earns no new saving. Live teaching and observation retain all time.
unknowns: Existing reusable materials and preparation effort
research_questions: Does a tagged case library reduce preparation without narrowing the intern's learning opportunities?

already_counted.description: Material selection, suitability and source checks

incremental.description: Refresh teaching cases and source versions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=15+80=95; gross 5 minus 2 upkeep gives net 3. High needs repeated assembly; low removes only 2 hours, offset by upkeep. Live teaching and feedback retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Purchase pharmacy supplies and maintain safe stock

steps.what: Check pharmaceutical supplies, expiry dates and usable stock quantities
Calculate purchase quantities and assemble pharmaceutical supply orders
Check purchase quantities, supplier and terms before ordering supplies
Receive, store and handle pharmaceutical supplies under required conditions

tasks.design: Configure reorder arithmetic in the pharmacy stock system {OTHER}, using checked usable quantities and approved parameters. The pharmacist reviews the exact order before purchase and retains physical receipt, storage and handling; shortages and substitutions return to manual decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Order assembly can repeat stock arithmetic and item entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reorder proposals can perform arithmetic without deciding clinical substitutes.
tasks.still_hard: Unreliable stock, shortages, storage conditions and controlled supply requirements.
tasks.human_edge: The pharmacist can reject a plausible order that would create clinical or storage risk.
tasks.altitude: Less order calculation with stock assurance and purchasing accountability intact.

reach.task: Record usable stock and flag expiry exceptions for review

evidence.claim: Native reorder arithmetic can reduce order preparation when reliable stock and approved parameters exist; no pharmacy-specific measured saving is supplied.

assumptions: Boundary includes pharmacist stock checks, order preparation, purchase and handling; supplier fulfilment time is excluded.
Pharmacist produces item identifier, unit, location, usable count, expiry exceptions and count timestamp in s1, with its full 30 hours retained. No trusted inventory feed is assumed.

Pharmacist checks target stock, minimum, pack multiple, open-order quantity and approved supplier in s2's retained 10 hours. Initial parameter capture is rollout work; recurring changes are upkeep. Missing or stale fields require manual calculation.
Test native proposals first; existing automatic ordering earns no new saving. s3 checks the final version, with changes requiring renewed review. No substitution or automatic purchase is introduced.
unknowns: Inventory accuracy and existing reorder functionality
Order preparation share and storage requirements
research_questions: Do native proposals reduce total preparation without increasing stock-outs, excess stock or expiry waste?

already_counted.description: Physical count and structured stock capture
Parameter checking and manual calculation exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain reorder parameters and audit stock/order mismatches

approvals.approved_version: Final item, unit, quantity, supplier, price and destination snapshot; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=30+10+20+30=90; gross 10 minus 2 upkeep gives net 8. High assumes repeated manual calculation; low removes only 2 hours, offset by upkeep. Counts, review and physical handling retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Manage pharmacy staff and daily operations

steps.what: Review pharmacy staffing, service needs and operational priorities
Perform administrative duties by entering agreed staffing and operational changes
Manage pharmacy operations and supervise staff through daily service issues

tasks.design: Configure native change forms and reusable fields in {HCM} and the pharmacy operations system {OTHER} for agreed staffing and operational updates. The pharmacist retains hiring or allocation decisions, staff supervision and service issue resolution; merchandise transactions require their own process if present.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated entry of agreed changes can duplicate fields across administrative screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can reuse identifiers and validate routine entries.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing staffing, competence, demand and staff concerns.
tasks.human_edge: The pharmacist can recognise when a workable rota would create an unsafe service.
tasks.altitude: Less routine entry; operational and employment decisions retain their authority.

reach.task: Report a capacity or service issue with the relevant facts

evidence.claim: Native change forms can reduce repeated administrative entry, while hiring and supervisory judgement remain; the allocation requires local validation.

assumptions: Boundary is a pharmacist manager's routine operations and staffing administration; hiring campaigns and merchandise sales are alternative activities, not assumed daily paperwork.

Pharmacist produces staff identifiers, assignment, effective date, affected service and decision rationale in s1 with 35 hours retained; s2 includes field capture, validation and exceptions within 20 retained hours.

No employee performance score, automatic hiring decision or free structured availability is assumed. Existing staff availability is checked manually in s1; new staff collection would be additional work.
Test native forms first. Missing records return to manual entry. Existing prefills earn no new gain; national staff consultation and access rules must be checked in rollout.
unknowns: Managerial duty mix and actual duplicate entry
Native form capability and staff consultation requirements
research_questions: Does reusable field entry reduce administration without introducing incorrect staffing changes?

already_counted.description: Record entry, field capture and validation

incremental.description: Maintain forms and inspect incorrect record updates

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=35+20+40=95; gross 5 minus 2 upkeep gives net 3. High assumes repeated administrative entry; low removes 2 hours, consumed by upkeep. Staff decisions and supervision keep all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select educational information, audience and current supporting sources
Draft educational information from selected source passages for the intended audience

loop.purpose: Draft audience-appropriate prose from approved source passages
loop.input: Verified publication brief and selected passages
loop.output: Draft with source references and uncertainty preserved
loop.check: Pharmacist verifies every clinical claim, contraindication, qualifier and audience implication against sources
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported or ambiguous claims require manual rewriting
loop.why_not_simpler: Audience adaptation needs language judgement beyond layout templates

steps.what: Check and publish the final educational information for the intended audience

tasks.design: Use templates in {DOCS} and a bounded source-restricted drafting loop for educational prose. The pharmacist checks clinical meaning, audience suitability and the final rendered version before publishing through {CMS} or the existing document route.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning checked source information into readable educational prose takes repeated drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Restricted drafting can reduce rewriting, while templates handle fixed structure.
tasks.still_hard: Preserving dose qualifiers, limitations and contraindications in accessible language.
tasks.human_edge: The pharmacist can see when a simplification would mislead readers into unsafe action.
tasks.altitude: Less prose drafting; clinical editorial responsibility remains personal.

reach.task: Check whether a patient education explanation is understandable in practice
reach.learn: Accessible communication and preserving clinical qualifications

evidence.claim: Thuisarts is a guideline-based patient-information source; this supports vetted sourcing, not a claim that a pharmacy publication generator is validated.
Restricted-source drafting may reduce educational prose rewriting if pharmacist checking is retained; the allocation is model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is general educational publishing, excluding individual patient advice and private clinical records.

Pharmacist produces topic, audience, scope, source title, version, passage and permitted clinical claims in s1; its full 30 hours include capture and source appraisal. No ready approved brief is assumed.
Native templates and reusable approved text are tested first. The loop only drafts where narrative adaptation is needed; source gaps return to manual writing in s2.

s3 checks meaning, references, accessibility and final rendering before publication. Approval binds that exact version; later changes require a fresh check. Existing editorial authority is assumed and must be confirmed.
Infrequent publication may make a maintained loop uneconomic; the conservative case limits gains to upkeep-equivalent drafting reductions.
unknowns: Publication volume and existing editorial process
Available approved sources and authority to publish
research_questions: Does total brief, draft and final-check time fall while all clinically significant qualifications remain accurate?

already_counted.description: Clinical source capture and brief preparation

incremental.description: Refresh sources, test drafting changes and review published corrections

approvals.approved_version: Final rendered text, references, audience and destination snapshot; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=30+20+30=80; gross 20 minus 4 upkeep gives net 16. High requires repeated audience adaptation of verified material; low removes only 4 hours in infrequent or difficult publications, offset by upkeep. Source appraisal and final checking keep all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce preparation and routine entry while keeping teaching, safe stock handling, staff management and clinical editorial decisions personal.
reach: Support technicians in structured stock capture and nurses in reviewing accessible medication education
role.ambitious_version: A pharmacist who spends less time assembling material and orders while sustaining safe service, teaching and clear medication education.
